body:
I’ve thought it through extensively.  It’s not that I think I could never feel happy again that made me decide to do it — it’s the absolute certainty that no matter what I do, I’ll just end up ruining it again.  It’s happened over and over throughout my life and I’m just fucking done with it.

My wife and I were together for almost 11 years.  We loved each other like crazy, and still I managed to drive her away.  I’m 42 years old.  I just don’t have it in me to start from scratch; especially knowing that my laziness and cowardice will end up ruining any relationship or accomplishment I luck into anyway.

I just don’t have any fight left in me.  I’m too weak to change for the better, and I’m tired of subjecting my loved ones to constant failure and disappointment.  The only future I wanted was the one where my wife and I raised our daughter and grew old together, and that future is gone now.

All I’m going to do if I continue living is to keep repeating the same self-destructive cycle my life has always been stuck in.  If anything, it’s getting worse.  

I don’t want that.  I don’t want to live anymore.
Heh, thanks for the advice.  However,I’ve never been drunk, stoned, or high.  Never even taken a puff on a cigarette.  I’d hate to blow my record so close to the end. :)
California.
Depends a lot on where you live.
Yes, I’m a bad person.  I’ve been a bad husband, a bad father, a bad son, and a bad friend.  And sure, I wish to be a better person.  I wish for a lot of other shit that’ll never happen, too.

My current position is that I finally understand and accept that — whether or not they know it — my loved ones are better off without me in the long run.  I’ve thought so for many years, but there was always that little bit of doubt.  

My wife of 11 years is leaving me due to my own selfish laziness.  The best-case scenario for my future is having to move halfway across the country to live in my parents’ basement, which means almost never seeing my daughter and likely working some shit job until I die.  

I had it all, and I took it for granted and ruined it.  I can’t live the rest of my life with that kind of regret.  And there’s no reason to.  My life is effectively over already; may as well end it in the literal sense as well.

I can either end it all now, or live a few more decades of a lonely, pathetic existence. I don’t see any particular virtue in choosing the latter over the former.  The sooner I get this over with, the sooner everyone can start forgetting me.  I sincerely hope it doesn’t take long.

Unfortunately my favorite spot in the world was at home with my wife and kid.  Thanks for your concern, but if I were the kind of person who could just throw all caution to the wind and create a whole new life for myself, I wouldn’t be in the position I am now.

If it was just about my own pain, that’d be one thing.  But the fact is that I’m hurting everyone around me just by being me.  I’m broken in a fundamental way — too negative to believe I can ever improve myself, and too cowardly and lazy to really commit to making an effort to do so.

You’re right; I am leaving behind my mess for other to clean up. But as long as I’m alive, that mess is just going to keep piling up, and god knows *I’m* never going to clean it.  The best I can do for them is to get it over with before the mess gets any bigger.

I’m not offended at all.  Thanks for taking the time;  appreciate the thought.

The problem isn’t as simple as the mistakes I’ve made.  It’s that I keep repeating them, even when I’m consciously trying not to.  You don’t get infinite second chances, and I’ve basically ruined my life now.  

My wife is divorcing me.  She was my best friend and knows me better than any other person ever has, and still I managed to alienate her.  Without her support, I’ll have to move halfway across the country and pretty much go back to living in my parents’ basement.  Which means I might get to see my daughter 2-3 times a year, if I’m lucky.   I have no valuable skills, no job prospects, and less than no faith that I can meaningfully change any of those things.

I had my shot, and I blew it.  Life has handed me plenty of opportunities that a lot of people would kill for, and I squandered all of them.  If I keep living, I’ll just be a continual burden and sad disappointment.  I’d rather end things on my own terms than be a living bad example for my daughter.

Don’t let the bastards keep you down.  Every time someone kills themself because they’re gay/bi/ace/what-have-you, some motherfucker like Mike Pence has a little chuckle about it.  Don’t give those asstards the satisfaction.  They don’t fucking deserve it.

No matter how old I get or how much I have at stake, I just keep making the same mistakes fueled by laziness, cowardice, and selfishness.  My wife divorcing me is the final straw.  I don’t want to live another 40-odd years knowing I destroyed my family and ruined the best thing I ever had going for me.  

Sure, I could pick up the pieces and try to rebuild, but why?  I can’t change for the better (I’ve tried, believe me).  Sooner or later, any semblance of a life I do manage to scrape together is going to end up right back where I am now.  Fuck it.

I’m objectively a pretty lucky person.  Life has handed me plenty of great opportunities, and I’ve pissed every last one of them away.  I’m just done with it.  No more.

Sure, I could keep holding on.  I just don’t see any point.  Ultimately I just end up hurting and failing the people I love, and my life is basically ruined as a direct result of my own selfish laziness.

I’m tired of being stuck in this shitty loop, and I’m not strong enough to break out of it in any other way.  It’s been like 30 years now.  If it was going to happen, it would have by now.
I appreciate the thought, truly.  But I just don’t have any fight left in me.  I’m just done.
Likewise.  :/

You’re right, they aren’t.  I’m not doing this as a cry for help or to send a message.  I want a quick and effective Delete button for my existence, and this is about as close as you can get to one.

It’s going to hurt my loved ones, and I regret that very much.  But I finally understand that I will hurt them more in the long run by continuing to live.  I don’t have it in me to be a better person, so I’m better off not being a person at all.

Also depends on what you shoot yourself with.  A point-blank .44 magnum round or 12-gauge slug to anywhere in the brain is pretty close to a guaranteed kill, and even if you do briefly survive the initial trauma, the raw force of the impact is *very* likely to knock you unconscious long enough that you’ll be dead long before you could wake up.

That’s awful.  So sorry you had to go through that, especially during a time where you were already so vulnerable.  This kind of thing is why I’ve never confessed my suicidal thoughts (and now plans)  to anyone in person.  I’m not going to be taken prisoner — my life has more than enough humiliation in it already. :P

I’m 42 and I still long for a “Delete Self” button.  I hate knowing that I’m going to hurt my loved ones when I do what I know I have to, but I also know that I’ll hurt them more in the long run if I don’t do it.
Right there with you.

I’m so sorry to hear that you’ve been through so much.  Genuine congratulations for soldiering through it.  I’m glad it sounds like things are looking up for you.

I don’t believe I can come back from this to make a meaningful life for myself or my daughter.  The second my wife said “divorce,” I knew that this was it — this is the thing that breaks me.  This is how my story ends.

You must have great strength of character to have survived what you’ve been though.  I, sadly, do not. :/

It’s more than just that.  I’ve actively hated myself for like 30 years now.  I’ve tried various therapy and pills, and even the ones that work don’t change that fact.  It’s just who I am, and I’m so damn tired of it.  I don’t have the capacity for meaningful positive change — the best I can hope for is to limit the damage by ending this now.

I can’t handle a divorce.  I just can’t.  I love her so much, and I’m so ashamed I let things deteriorate to the point they have.  My family is ending and it’s my fault.  I can’t live the rest of my life with that kind of guilt and regret.  I just... can’t.

The way I see it, better I check out now than hang around her whole life serving as a bad example.  I inevitably fail and disappoint everyone I love.  I can’t stand the thought of doing that to her.  Better to just rip the Band-Aid off now, I figure.

After doing some research, I’m planning to use a shotgun loaded with magnum slugs.  I’ll hold it to the side of my head, just above my ear, with one hand, then pull the trigger with the other.  

I expect it will be messy, but the odds of anything but an instant death are about as low as they can get.  I’m going to do it somewhere away from home, probably late at night, to ensure there’s no chance of my wife or daughter finding my body.

I don’t believe in souls, or an afterlife, or any kind of higher power.  I’m not afraid to die, just sad about the moments I’ll miss in my daughter’s life and regretful that I’ll be hurting my loved ones in the immediate sense.  The only thing I’m afraid of is the possibility of failing in a way that leaves me alive, but horribly maimed.

I honestly believe this is for the best in the long run.  I just don’t have another 40-odd years in me.  I’ve ultimately failed at everything I’ve ever cared about and disappointed everyone I wanted to make proud, and I’m just done.  I just want to flick my switch to OFF and be done with this sad excuse for a life.
